articles.summary: Navacaprant did not achieve the primary endpoint in KOASTAL-2 or -3; Company to discontinue development of navacaprant Advancing potential best-in-class programs with NMRA-511 in Alzheimer’s disease agitation, NMRA-898 in schizophrenia and NMRA-215 in cardiometabolic disease Aligning organization
